Strategy: Piecewise residual preference. Exact fits score highest; post-placement residuals of 1–10 score far below looser fits, since such gaps likely cannot hold future items; larger residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit exactly when the tightest fit would leave a residual of 1–10, in which case a looser bin preserves a usable gap. It may help by cutting unusable waste, but may fail if future items are small enough to use those gaps.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-100.0 + (r - item) if r - item <= 10 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Piecewise residual preference: exact fit highest, residual 1-10 penalized as dead zone, larger residuals Best-Fit-like.
